sources.title: bge small en — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact, no-frills embedding specialist that punches above its weight for its size. It converts English text into dense vector representations efficiently, making it practical for resource-constrained environments where larger models would be overkill. Its small footprint means faster inference and lower memory usage, though it trades some representational depth for that efficiency.
